findings.entity: waitress reflection and truck trailer surface
findings.description: The reflection of the waitress is incorrectly rendered onto the exterior side panel of the truck trailer parked outside the window. As the man walks outside toward the truck, he occludes the reflection, showing that the reflection layer was improperly placed in 3D depth behind the man on the truck body rather than on the foreground window pane.
